content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments refer to the ability to accept cryptocurrency transactions via the Solana blockchain. This decentralized option allows digital creators to sell products such as ebooks, courses, and templates without dependency on traditional payment processors. Unlike platforms like Gumroad that charge hefty fees, Solana transactions through NOWPayments incur only a 0.5% fee, significantly increasing profitability for creators. For instance, on a $97 product, saving $921 at 100 sales per month is a compelling reason to consider this infrastructure shift.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for Solana payments is built on a series of interconnected components that facilitate seamless transactions. It leverages the Solana blockchain's high throughput for fast transaction times, combined with NOWPayments for automatic payment processing. By utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, creators can automate order fulfillment and product delivery. This architecture not only provides reliability but also ensures that creators maintain full ownership and control over their digital products and customer data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment structure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment systems are either unavailable or unsustainable. Creators selling digital goods such as software, beats, fonts, and online courses can benefit from the low fees and instant payment confirmations that Solana payments offer. This approach empowers creators to operate independently, ensuring that they can sell their products without the fear of payment processing limitations.
Keep 99.5% of your sales revenue with Solana payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of Solana payments involves a combination of key components. Firstly, the use of a digital wallet compatible with Solana is essential for receiving payments. Secondly, integrating NOWPayments allows for cryptocurrency transactions to be accepted effortlessly. Finally, using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend operations ensures smooth product delivery and order management. Together, these components create a robust and efficient system for digital commerce.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start leveraging Solana payments for your digital products, first set up a compatible digital wallet to receive Solana cryptocurrency. Next, integrate NOWPayments into your website or application to handle transactions. Utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery upon receipt of payment. Finally, test the entire system to ensure that payments are processed correctly, and you're ready to start selling.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing Solana payments. Accept cryptocurrency directly through NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction. This method allows you to retain more of your earnings and simplify your payment processing, ensuring that you can focus on creating content instead of dealing with platform restrictions.
Automate delivery and payment processing seamlessly with Cloudflare Workers.

This all-in-one package includes everything needed for deploying a sovereign payment solution, allowing you to sell without traditional platform fees. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
